tools.name: scheduleit_list_events
tools.description: List scheduled events and tasks (bookings, shifts, jobs). Without date_from/date_to Schedule It uses its default date range. Schedule It returns only a short summary of each event unless you name the fields you want: pass `fields` such as id,title,date_start,date_end,owner,notes,completed,priority,c

tools.name: scheduleit_get_event
tools.description: One event or task by id with ALL its fields (title, dates, linked resources, notes, completion, priority, custom fields). GET /api/events/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_event
tools.description: WRITE: create a new event (booking, shift, job or task) in the Schedule It account, optionally linked to resources. It becomes visible to everyone with access to the schedule, and Schedule It may notify the linked resources according to the account's own notification settings. Confirm the title, dat

tools.name: scheduleit_update_event
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are changed, the rest stay as they are. Passing resource_ids replaces the whole list of linked resources; an empty string clears notes or a custom field. Changing dates or resources may notify people per the account's notification s

tools.name: scheduleit_delete_event
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete one event or task. It cannot be undone through the API. Only call this when the user clearly asked for this event to be deleted. DELETE /api/events/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_resources
tools.description: List resources: the people, rooms, equipment or vehicles that events are scheduled against. Schedule It returns only a short summary unless you pass `fields` (for example id,name,email,data1; get_resource returns ALL fields of one). Resources belong to groups (`owner` = group ids). There is no pagin

tools.name: scheduleit_get_resource
tools.description: One resource by id with ALL its fields (name, email, groups, details 1-10, colours, skills). GET /api/resources/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_resource
tools.description: WRITE: add a new resource (a person, room, piece of equipment) to the Schedule It account. It may count toward the account's licensed resources or users. Confirm the details with the user first. POST /api/resources.

tools.name: scheduleit_update_resource
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing resource; only the fields you pass are changed. Passing group_ids replaces the whole list of groups; an empty string clears email or a detail field. POST /api/resources/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_groups
tools.description: List resource groups (the categories resources are organised in, e.g. Staff, Rooms, Vehicles). Pass `fields` (e.g. id,name) for more than the short summary. GET /api/groups.

tools.name: scheduleit_get_group
tools.description: One resource group by id with ALL its fields. GET /api/groups/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_group
tools.description: WRITE: add a new resource group to the Schedule It account. POST /api/groups.

tools.name: scheduleit_update_group
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing resource group; only the fields you pass are changed. POST /api/groups/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels that can be put on events (for example Confirmed, Urgent). Pass `fields` (e.g. id,name) for more than the short summary. GET /api/labels.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_label_groups
tools.description: List label groups (the categories that labels are organised in). Pass `fields` (e.g. id,name) for more than the short summary. GET /api/labelgroups.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scheduleit_update_event, scheduleit_list_resources, scheduleit_get_resource, scheduleit_update_resource · Public sink: scheduleit_create_event, scheduleit_update_event, scheduleit_list_resources, scheduleit_get_resource, scheduleit_create_resource, scheduleit_update_resource, scheduleit_create_group, scheduleit_update_group · Destructive: scheduleit_delete_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scheduleit_update_event, scheduleit_list_resources, scheduleit_get_resource, scheduleit_update_resource · Public sink: scheduleit_create_event, scheduleit_update_event, scheduleit_list_resources, scheduleit_get_resource, scheduleit_create_resource, scheduleit_update_resource, scheduleit_create_group, scheduleit_update_group · Destructive: scheduleit_delete_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
